sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, French Civil Law, and customary law as recognised under the Constitution)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No standalone bilateral investment treaty currently in force; zero-income-tax regime provides the primary investment framework
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER-Plus) regional trade framework

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Companies in the source jurisdiction / duly notarised copy
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization if issuing state is not an Apostille party)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notary public in the country of issue

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and credit standing certificate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular route for non-Apostille jurisdictions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or corporate due diligence report for the proposed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: VFSC-licensed registered agent or source-country registry

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons under FATF Recommendations 12 and 22; screening of all UBOs and directors against UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK HMT, Australian DFAT and Vanuatu domestic sanctions/terrorism-financing lists; source-of-funds verification and ongoing transaction monitoring required.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Registry online clearance portal (www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory names must be in Latin script. English, French and Bislama spellings are accepted. Non-Latin scripts require a transliteration into English. Names must terminate with an acceptable corporate identifier such as 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Inc' or 'Société Anonyme'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 14 days of rejection, submit a written request for reconsideration to the VFSC Companies Registrar (registry@vfsc.vu) with supporting legal and factual reasoning. A one-time extension of up to 30 days is available if applied for before expiry. If refused, lodge an administrative review with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Board and thereafter an originating application to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are not sufficient. A physical registered office in Vanuatu maintained by a VFSC-licensed registered agent is mandatory. P.O. boxes and residential virtual addresses are not accepted. Books, minutes, share register and registered-account records must remain accessible in Vanuatu.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to moderate for a standard off-price apparel trading company: approximately 5% annual probability of an unannounced registered-agent inspection or VFSC supervisory visit, increasing to 20-30% where sanctions-listed counterparties, negative adverse media or PEP alerts are identified.

Government incorporation fee for International Company (standard authorised share capital)
Registered agent and registered office services (first year)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial fee statutes and apostille tariffs

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Cap. 222) as amended; principal formation provisions at sections 5, 9, 11 and 14 (incorporation, registered office, constitution and certificate of incorporation).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association on Form IC-1 together with Application for Registration of an International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; authorized capital may be expressed in any major currency; no statutory escrow deposit required for an International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: 1. That the International Company was duly registered under the International Companies Act 1992 and the subscribers in the Memorandum and Articles of Association are confirmed as foundation shareholders. 2. That one ordinary share be issued to the subscriber named in the register of members at par value subscribed. 3. That the registered office located at Port Vila, Vanuatu, as filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, is adopted as the statutory registered office of the Company. 4. That the directors named in the Form IC-1 be appointed as first directors, and the secretary named therein be appointed. 5. That directors are jointly authorized to open bank accounts and execute banking mandates.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, International Companies Registry, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name clearance request through the VFSC online e-Registry or in person at the Registry counter, stating the proposed company name and evidence of distinction from existing registered names. Pay the name reservation fee. Receive written name approval or rejection notice.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation draft name statement
Identification of proposed subscriber or agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused due to conflict or undesirable character, file a formal appeal or alternative name request with the VFSC within 7 days and pay the resubmission fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent approved by VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute Memorandum and Articles of Association in English or French. The document must be signed by the subscriber or shareholders, witnessed, and delivered to the VFSC for registration. The constitutional documents must comply with section 9 of the International Companies Act 1992.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Form IC-1)
Certificate of registered office in Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries compliance, amend the defective clauses through a supplementary resolution or provide supporting declarations within 14 days and re-file for registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Companies Registration Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the executed Form IC-1 and supporting documents with the VFSC, remit the statutory registration fee, and submit the directors and secretary consent forms. The Registrar will review and issue the Certificate of Incorporation upon approval.
required_dossiers: Consent of first directors and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registration application is rejected or placed under query, correct the stated deficiencies and resubmit through the registered agent within 10 working days or seek written reasons for rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and corporate book opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, collect or download the Certificate of Incorporation, and prepare the registered office minutes, share register, seal, and statutory company records. Appoint directors and secretary if not already appointed.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains clerical or legal name typographical errors, apply to VFSC for administrative rectification within 5 days without loss of incorporation date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of commercial presence and bank facilitation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, and VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the International Company for tax identification under Tax Identification Numbering Rules if obtaining a local VAT registration, and open the corporate bank account with a licensed Vanuatu bank, presenting the Certificate of Incorporation and board resolution.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of directors and beneficial owner declarations
Registered agent certificate of good standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank inquiries arise, file a beneficial ownership declaration with the VFSC or provide enhanced due diligence documents through the registered agent to satisfy bank compliance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: N/A — no industrial licensing board applies to international company wholesale garment trading
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: N/A — no operating, manufacturing or wholesale trading license is required under Vanuatu law for this activity

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — activity involves no manufacturing, waste discharge or site alteration
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater or VOC discharge thresholds apply; all warehouse and office waste must be handled in compliance with the Waste Management Act and general environmental nuisance provisions.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire safety certification or structural load inspection is required for an office-only wholesale liquidation operation; general workplace safety under Vanuatu Occupational Safety and Health rules applies to leased commercial premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department (CIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official e-services portal: https://www.customs.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax. A foreign entity or International Company (IC) wishing to transact in Vanuatu or to claim input VAT recovery must obtain a VAT registration number by submitting the VAT 1 Application for Registration form to the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, together with certified constitutional documents, proof of registered agent address in Vanuatu, and a VAT-compliant invoice/record system. An IC incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] is statutorily tax-exempt and prohibited from carrying on business with Vanuatu residents; registration is mandatory only when annual taxable turnover equals or exceeds VUV 10,000,000 or when the IC elects to register to claim export-related input VAT refunds.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election and no hybrid mismatch election exist under Vanuatu law. The International Company (IC) operates under a statutory absolute income-tax exemption; no entity classification election is available or required. A de facto election exists for VAT purposes only: a person may voluntarily register for VAT below the VUV 10,000,000 threshold to obtain input tax credits on export procurement, with registration becoming compulsory upon exceeding the threshold.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 255] of Vanuatu
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 10,000,000 annual taxable turnover (equivalent to approximately USD 85,000); an offshore International Company whose supplies are made to non-residents and whose goods never enter Vanuatu may be regarded as outside the territorial scope of VAT, in which case no registration is triggered
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Vanuatu currently imposes no real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, API data transmission, or digital stamping mandate. Taxpayers must issue paper or PDF tax invoices containing the issuer's name and address, the VAT registration number, the invoice issue date, a description of the supply, the VAT-exclusive amount, the VAT amount at 12.5%, and the total due. Invoices and supporting records must be retained for at least seven years for audit purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods from Vanuatu are zero-rated under Item 1 of the First Schedule to the VAT Act, provided the goods are physically exported within the statutory timeframe, the supplier retains documentary proof of export, and the supply is made to a recipient outside Vanuatu. For an offshore IC engaged in off-price wholesale liquidation of branded overstock garments, zero-rating applies where finished garments are routed through Vanuatu customs for re-export; where goods are sold and shipped directly between third countries without entering Vanuatu, the transaction falls entirely outside the Vanuatu VAT net and no VAT is chargeable. Input VAT on procurement attributable to exported goods is refundable to a registered person.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Vanuatu Customs Form CED)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical departure from Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate or foreign-currency bank credit advice (SWIFT) evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Commercial Invoice and itemized Packing List
Original Purchase Order and Supply Contract with the overseas buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Exporters are subject to targeted audits comparing customs export declarations, shipping manifests, and banking records. Fraudulent or unsupported zero-rating claims expose the taxpayer to a 25% tax penalty on the understated VAT, interest accruing, and a retrospective clawback of input VAT refunds with a limitation period of up to seven years where fraud or deliberate evasion is established. Criminal prosecution may result in fines of up to VUV 2,000,000 and/or imprisonment for responsible officers. The Commissioner of Customs and Inland Revenue may also cancel the IC's VAT registration and impose deregistration penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) - the central bank and foreign exchange administration, operating under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act and the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 90].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains a liberal but formally regulated convertibility regime under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 90], administered by the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu through authorised dealer banks. Current account transactions (trade, services, repatriation of profits) are freely convertible without prior approval; capital account injections and liquidation proceeds also move freely with only statistical reporting, no licence and no surrender charge. The Vatu is not an internationally traded currency offshore, yet the elimination of corporate/income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax and remittance tax for International Companies means profit remittance hurdles arise exclusively at bank compliance level: documentation of beneficial ownership, source of funds and underlying trade. Practical convertibility risk exists in correspondent banking de-risking rather than in statutory exchange controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu has no statutory export-proceeds surrender or conversion deadline. There is no requirement for wholesale exporters or re-export traders to convert USD/EUR/AUD receipts into Vatu, nor to repatriate proceeds within a specified window; receipts may be retained in foreign-currency accounts at a licensed authorised dealer. The only obligations are passive: accurate labelling of receipts in the RBV balance-of-payments statistical reporting and, where goods physically pass through Port Vila/Havannah Harbour, submission of the approved customs declaration and the standard offshore goods documentation. As the off-price apparel liquidation is likely conducted on a re-invoicing or transit-trade basis with goods moving from third-country suppliers to third-country buyers, Vanuatu customs and surrender rules will not be triggered.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational multi-currency current account (VUV/USD/AUD) with SWIFT and trade-desk access; capital escrow sub-account available for shareholder injections
Operational settlement account (VUV/USD/EUR) plus documentary letter-of-credit issuance line; capital escrow account for inbound equity and intercompany funding
Operational VUV current account only; limited USD facility and no dedicated trade-LC desk for offshore International Companies

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Low. Vanuatu-domiciled International Companies are generally rejected by regulated offshore digital EMIs and fintech banking platforms (including UK FCA e-money firms, EU PSD2 payment institutions and US money-transmitter challenger banks) because the jurisdiction carries an elevated FATF/EU monitoring history and the IC structure typically lacks a public UBO register. The VFSC does not issue a cross-border EMI licence of international standing, and the local National Payment Switch enables only domestic VUV card/payment transfers, not outbound trade treasury. EMIs are usable only where the parent group is resident in a top-tier OECD jurisdiction and acts as the contracting treasury entity, with the Vanuatu IC settling via intercompany allocations. This disqualifies EMIs as a primary treasury rail and requires a conventional bank-led architecture.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance before either the bank's principal officer in Port Vila or the regional head-office relationship team (for ANZ) is effectively mandatory for the Ultimate Beneficial Owner and one authorised signatory. The registered agent's certification alone is no longer sufficient following the jurisdiction's re-rating and increasing EDD expectations. Remote/video onboarding may be tolerated only where the UBO undergoes a video/telephonic interview arranged by a Vanuatu-licensed trust company with a pre-existing banker's reference from a Tier-1 foreign bank; in practice, new offshore IC account openings are subject to at least one physical or consular-verified in-person identity step and wet-ink signature verification. Foreign-remote-only KYC (digital signature, no interview) is not accepted by the authorised dealer community.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore opacity red flags — bearer-share availability, private register of members and director nominee structures
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Certificate of Incumbency and statutory Register of Members/Directors; explicit written confirmation that no bearer shares are in issue and that the articles prohibit bearer shares going forward; full UBO chain showing natural persons holding more than 25%; VFSC annual compliance certificate; registered-agent declaration pointing to its AML file.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Higher-risk jurisdiction overlay — FATF/EU monitoring of Vanuatu
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced Due Diligence pack: regulated introducer letter and due-diligence check of the registered agent, independent sanctions and adverse-media screening results for all UBOs, an audited source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statement for the paid-in capital, and a board resolution appointing signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering suspicion on discounted brand liquidation invoices
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transaction trail: liquidation supply contract and platform audit statement, manufacturer's rejection/overstock certificate, original commercial invoices and packing lists, bill of lading/airway bill, insurance certificates, and third-party price benchmark (off-price comparator) to substantiate invoice credibility.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Economic-substance and substance inadequacy (distribution and service centre) risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 declaration and records: registered office and agent in Vanuatu, physical premises or outsourced VFSC-administrator arrangement, board minutes evidencing direction and control; confirmation that the relevant activity is 'distribution and service centre' with substance documentation if the threshold is crossed.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Passport/identity quality issues under historical CBI (Citizenship by Investment) and PEP screening
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UBO passports from the domicile jurisdiction (not Vanuatu-issued CBI passports), notarised proof of tax residence and physical presence, PEP/sanctions search output from a recognised screening solution, and independent verification of bank/source references from a Tier-1 home-country financial institution.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections are executed by SWIFT MT103 from the home-country bank of the shareholder/parent to the IC's VUV/USD operational or escrow account at BRED or ANZ in Port Vila. Remittance must be coded as 'Capital Contribution / Issue of Share Capital' (or 'Shareholder Loan' for intercompany debt) in the purpose field; the bank will record it on the RBV balance-of-payments statistical return. The remitter must match the certificate of incumbency shareholder register, and the IC must supply board resolutions, share certificates, and — for amounts above the bank's EDD threshold (commonly USD 50,000) — source-of-wealth affidavits and the underlying purchase/funding agreement. Since an IC is tax-exempt, there is no stamp duty on the equity issue and no FX surrender; nevertheless, the bank will verify that the funds were not routed through anonymous wallet structures or jurisdictions with active sanctions.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary payment rail is SWIFT MT103 / MT202 cover for direct supplier remittances from the IC's foreign-currency settlement account; documentary trades are serviced by irrevocable, unconfirmed or confirmed letters of credit (MT700 issue / MT707 amendment / MT752 acknowledgement / MT740 reimbursement) arranged with ANZ or BRED and routed through top-tier correspondent banks in Australia, Singapore or Hong Kong. ACH_Direct is not a permitted rail on the VUV domestic interface and is relevant only where the group maintains a US-dollar clearing sub-account with a US correspondent or a bank-integrated treasury account in the United States for domestic supplier payments. The bank will require the standard goods trail (purchase order, commercial invoice, packing list, transport document, customs or bonded warehouse entry) for every cross-border disbursement; however, no RBV foreign-exchange approval or export certificate is required for such outbound trade payments.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanuatu Vatu / USD deliverable FX forwards (up to 12 months) executed with ANZ Bank (Vanuatu) Limited or BRED Bank (Vanuatu) Limited for working-capital conversion
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing VUV/USD available via parent-company treasury with top-tier market counterparties; limited liquidity above USD 5 million notional
Cross-currency swaps (USD/VUV) via a licensed dealer for balance-sheet hedging, subject to the bank's internal risk approval
Plain vanilla foreign-exchange spot contracts through resident authorised dealers for current-account settlements

Over-the-counter forward contracts with international FX brokers where a parent-company guarantee is provided; no local derivatives exchange is available and exchange-traded options/futures are not commonly accessible for VUV

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the anniversary of the date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs a VUV 10,000 penalty and suspension of Certificate of Good Standing; default for more than 3 months triggers administrative dissolution proceedings under the International Companies Act [Cap 222].

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Fee and Confirmation of Good Standing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation with a 30-day payment grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a 10% surcharge on the annual fee; non-payment for 90 days results in administrative strike-off by the Registrar and vesting of company assets with the Government of Vanuatu.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual AML/CFT Beneficial Owner Re-Verification and Compliance Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent under VFSC AML/CFT supervision (International Companies Act and AML/CFT Regulations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On the incorporation anniversary, aligned with the annual return; immediately upon any change in beneficial ownership or shareholding
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to provide updated UBO information obliges the agent to report the deficiency to VFSC, may result in termination of the registered agent engagement, and can lead to strike-off of the company for absence of a valid registered agent.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit requirement for a standard Vanuatu International Company not conducting business in Vanuatu and not holding a regulated VFSC license. Audit becomes compulsory only if the company's Articles of Association or a special resolution of shareholders so require, or if the entity holds a VFSC-regulated financial license (out of scope for this ISIC 4641 wholesale apparel entity).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory framework for International Companies; management accounts may be prepared under IFRS or simplified internal accounting records, and financial statements are exempt from filing with VFSC and remain confidential.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no public UBO register. The registered agent must annually re-verify the beneficial owners, update the internal register upon any share transfer, and retain a written confirmation of control positions in the corporate file under AML/CFT obligations. Share transfers are not filed with VFSC, and confidentiality of ownership is preserved.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (including share transfer ledger)
Minute Book of directors' and shareholders' meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; USD 0 - 2,500 for a voluntary compilation, review, or certification engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no general corporate income tax on any company, resident or non-resident.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies (ICs) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] are wholly tax-exempt: no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, and no withholding taxes. The only recurring state impost is the VFSC annual registration fee. Pure offshore trading of finished garments (off-price liquidation) with no Vanuatu-resident counterparties and no importation of goods into Vanuatu customs territory gives an effective tax rate of 0%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists for Vanuatu ICs. The only periodic filing is the IC Annual Return (Form VFSC IC-AR), submitted by a VFSC-licensed registered agent through the VFSC e-filing / registered-agent portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation; the corresponding annual government fee is payable with the return as per the VFSC Fee Schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name (must end with 'Limited') and VFSC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the name exactly as on the Certificate of Incorporation; no local branch registration is required for foreign owners.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Street address of the registered office maintained by the registered agent; a PO Box alone is not acceptable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered office must remain in Vanuatu; this is normally supplied by the licensed agent at no additional operational burden.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, licence number, and contact details of the VFSC-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Appoint and maintain one VFSC-licensed agent; the agent is the formal channel for all statutory notices and fee payments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, addresses, nationalities, and dates of birth of all directors and the company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident natural persons or corporate directors are permitted; a minimum of one director is required and must act with real decision-making authority.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Shareholder and Beneficial Owner Register
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued share capital, classes of shares, and ultimate beneficial ownership schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose all ultimate beneficial owners for AML/CFT compliance; bearer shares are prohibited and nominee chains must be documented.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration confirming the IC has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents and holds no interest in real property in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain the tax exemption by confirming that all apparel-liquidation turnover is sourced from non-resident buyers and that goods never enter Vanuatu customs territory.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers VFSC administrative late fees, loss of Certificate of Good Standing, and potential deregistration; persistent default results in strike-off and dissolution. Directors who knowingly permit the default may incur personal fines under the International Companies Act.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu VAT Return (Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR) e-filing portal)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Return and payment due by the last business day of the month following the VAT period. Standard rate 12.5%; exports zero-rated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of supplies of goods and services made in Vanuatu subject to VAT at 12.5%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC with no Vanuatu-resident customers and no local delivery has no taxable supplies and is not required to register for VAT (registration threshold: annual turnover exceeding VUV 4,000,000 from Vanuatu supplies).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of exported goods evidenced by shipping and customs documentation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border overstock wholesale shipments are zero-rated where title and risk transfer outside Vanuatu; retain bills of lading, invoices, and payment records.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late lodgement attracts penalty tax of up to 25% of the VAT shortfall plus interest; habitual default allows DCIR to issue a default assessment and initiate customs enforcement proceedings.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu abolished all withholding taxes with effect from 1 August 2005; dividend distributions by an International Company are free of any Vanuatu tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement in force; only a limited network of bilateral Tax Information Exchange Agreements is operational. Because the statutory dividend withholding rate is nil, no treaty-relief claim, Tax Residency Certificate, or administrative waiver is required. Repatriation of dividends, share-redemption proceeds, and liquidation surpluses is unrestricted: Vanuatu imposes no exchange control or capital controls. The beneficial owner's home jurisdiction may apply its own CFC, foreign-dividend, or transparency rules; a factual company-status letter can be issued by the VFSC, but it does not confer treaty entitlement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on outbound royalties and interest; treaty rates are inapplicable because no DTA network exists. Payments to foreign licensors or lenders incur no Vanuatu tax, provided the underlying IP is not exploited in Vanuatu and no Vanuatu-resident payer is involved.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing legislation, no Local File / Master File obligation, and no statutory threshold expressed in VUV. Best practice nonetheless requires documented arm's-length pricing for intercompany inventory purchases, management fees, and cost recharges to withstand foreign tax authority audits.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has endorsed the OECD/G20 BEPS standard but has not enacted a comprehensive Economic Substance Regulations statute applicable to ordinary International Companies. The International Companies Act deems an IC non-resident and prohibits it from carrying on business in Vanuatu, holding local real property, or soliciting local investments. Therefore, local substance is typically confined to the registered agent, registered office, and board records. An IC performing 'relevant activities' (notably distribution and service-centre functions in the garment-liquidation trade) must demonstrate genuine management, employees, and premises in its jurisdiction of tax residence to foreign revenue authorities; a letter-box conclusion may result in the foreign jurisdiction treating the IC as transparent and re-attributing the taxable profit to the ultimate shareholder.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC as an undisclosed vehicle to divert and conceal taxable trading profits from the beneficial owner's home-country revenue authority, paired with false declarations to the VFSC regarding turnover, beneficiary, or value of goods.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu criminal liability for dishonest misrepresentation to public authorities; in the owner's home jurisdiction (e.g., US, UK, AU), criminal tax-fraud prosecution, back taxes, interest, and penalties up to 200% of the tax evaded.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approve false records are personally liable for civil restitution of diverted profits and penalties, may be disqualified from acting as directors, and face criminal prosecution with custodial sentences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a pure letter-box company with nominee directors, no board minutes, no inventory records, and no genuine decision-making for the apparel-liquidation trade, while claiming full tax-exempt status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Local remedy: VFSC strike-off or deregistration and disqualification of the registered agent. Foreign remedy: re-characterisation of the IC as a sham, denial of the 0% effective rate, and application of GAAR, CFC, or offshore-fund rules to re-attribute profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil; nominee directors face disqualification orders, freezing of personal assets, and secondary liability for the company's unpaid foreign taxes and penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / CFT Breach and Undisclosed Beneficial Ownership
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain a beneficial-ownership register, use of non-transparent bearer or custodial structures, movement of liquidation proceeds through third-country shell accounts without adequate customer due diligence, or handling proceeds of customs or VAT fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Vanuatu's Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act No. 1 of 2020: on conviction, a fine up to VUV 100,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 15 years for money laundering; licensed agents are also individually fined for deficient filings.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are criminally liable if knowingly involved; courts may issue travel bans, seizure orders, proceeds-of-crime confiscation, and orders for civil restitution to affected parties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Breach of International Company Statutory Restrictions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Carrying on business with Vanuatu residents, holding or leasing real property in Vanuatu, conducting regulated banking, insurance, or trust business without a licence, or inviting the Vanuatu public to subscribe for its shares.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offence under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]: fines imposed on the company and every defaulting officer, revocation of the exempt status, and strike-off by the VFSC with possible re-assessment of waived taxes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director who authorises the prohibited activity is jointly and severally liable for fines and for taxes re-assessed on the company; repeat offenders face disqualification and, where fraud is proven, imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Filings and Misrepresentation to VFSC
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly submitting false annual returns, forged board resolutions, fictitious shareholder schedules, or misleading certificates of good standing, or concealing a change of control.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties for false declarations under the International Companies Act, including fines and imprisonment; cancellation of the company's registration without prejudice to third-party claims.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The signatory director and the registered agent are personally liable to the VFSC for investigation costs and penalties; individuals may be prohibited from holding corporate offices in Vanuatu and are subject to criminal prosecution.
